name: System Metrics
author: Alex Takitani
description: Your whole system at a glance: live CPU, temperature, power, memory, GPU, network and disk gauges on your bar, with the detail one click away — per-core grid, top processes by CPU and memory, per-device watts. Save the logs and analyze them later: record the sensors you pick to compressed CSV, then hand the log to your AI agent in one click. No daemon; reads /proc and /sys directly, about 13 µs per tick.

barWidget.description: Live system metric gauges; click for per-core and per-device detail
